caption: The drawing features a single object that appears to be a metallic or dark-colored vessel or container mounted on a stand. The object is symmetrically centered within a lightly outlined rectangular border. The vessel has a cylindrical body with a slightly flared, rounded top and a flat upper surface, from which a pair of parallel vertical slots or prongs extend upwards. The cylindrical body narrows at the bottom, connecting to a rounded, ornate stem. The stem leads to a broad, tiered circular base, which widens significantly, providing support. The image is rendered in shades of black and gray, using smooth gradients and shadows to emphasize the three-dimensional, reflective quality of the object. The background is a light, off-white color, with minimal texture, and the artist's name, "Eugene J. Brannell," is signed in cursive at the bottom right corner within the border.
title: Lamp
